import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_ieee_set_mode(int precision, int rounding, int exception_mask)
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Python wrapper function
def set_ieee_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask):
    return gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Constants for testing
    GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION = 0
    GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION = 1
    GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION = 2
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST = 0
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN = 1
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP = 2
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO = 3
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID = 1 << 0
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_DENORMALIZED = 1 << 1
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO = 1 << 2
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW = 1 << 3
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW = 1 << 4
    GSL_SUCCESS = 0

    # Test with single precision and round to nearest
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST, 0)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Expected {GSL_SUCCESS}, got {result}"

    # Test with double precision and round down
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN, GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Expected {GSL_SUCCESS}, got {result}"

    # Test with extended precision and round up
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP, GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Expected {GSL_SUCCESS}, got {result}"

    # Test with round to zero and mask overflow
    result = set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO, GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW)
    assert result == GSL_SUCCESS, f"Expected {GSL_SUCCESS}, got {result}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
